author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
My junior engineer encountered delta cycle issue for the very first time.

I actually banned him from using AI to fix the code, he has to learn how to fix it by hand the hard way.

Delta circle is something like maths proves your learn it school. You need to learn it from first principles so that you never has to deal with it ever again in your life.
